title: Sortable Tree
description: Reorder nested data with pointer or keyboard controls and constrain movement to the hierarchy rules required by the product.

controls.title: Component controls
controls.description: Change the options below, then drag an item's handle to verify its behavior.

tree.label: Entire tree
tree.description: Move items vertically and change their depth.

sameDepth.description: Keep depth while moving across branches.

siblings.description: Reorder items only within one parent.
